description: This file defines the ProductWorker utility class for the OFBiz framework, providing static methods related to product processing, such as calculating weight, handling variants, retrieving features, checking inventory availability, and other product-related logic. It serves as a helper class to reduce code in JSPs and other components.

classes.name: ProductWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for product-related operations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: shippingApplies
methods.description: Determines if shipping charges should apply to a given product based on its type and attributes.

methods.name: isBillableToAddress
methods.description: Checks if a product is billable to a specific postal address.

methods.name: isShippableToAddress
methods.description: Checks if a product can be shipped to a specific postal address.

methods.name: isAllowedToAddress
methods.description: Internal logic to determine authorization for shipping or billing to an address based on geo restrictions.

methods.name: isSerialized
methods.description: Checks if a product is serialized based on its inventory item type.

methods.name: taxApplies
methods.description: Returns whether tax applies to a product based on its properties.

methods.name: getInstanceAggregatedId

methods.name: getAggregatedInstanceId

methods.name: getVariantVirtualId

methods.name: getVariantVirtualAssocs

methods.name: isProductInventoryAvailableByFacility

methods.name: getOptionalProductFeatures

methods.name: getAverageProductRating

methods.name: getCurrentProductCategories
